verdicts.title: Generic properties of minimal surfaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $M$ be an open Riemann surface and $n\ge 3$ be an integer. In this paper we establish some generic properties (in Baire category sense) in the space of all conformal minimal immersions $M\to\mathbb{R}^n$ endowed with the compact-open topology, pointing out that a generic such immersion is chaotic in many ways. verdicts.title: The local index density of the perturbed de Rham complex
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A closed 1-form $Θ$ on a manifold induces a perturbation $d_Θ$ of the de~Rham complex.
